result.title: Latent Flow Matching for Molecular Graph Generation
result.summary: Modern graph generative models typically operate directly in the discrete graph space, explicitly generating node and edge variables, which can become costly as graphs grow. In this paper, we perform generation explicitly on latent representations of entire graphs obtained from a pretrained Variational Autoencoder with high reconstruction fidelity. The generated representations, obtained through flow matching, are then decoded only at the final step. Across molecular benchmarks of increasing size, our approach achieves strong validity and FCD while offering a favorable quality-efficiency trade-off compared with state-of-the-art explicit graph generative models. One of the main advantages of this formulation is that the graph representation only needs to be learned once, after which the same one can be reused across multiple generative objectives without retraining. We demonstrate generation guided by molecular properties and further introduce validity-aware generation though a classifier learned directly in latent space. All code will be made available upon acceptance.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文在预训练 VAE 的高保真图 latent 空间上用 flow matching 做分子图生成，仅在最后一步解码，并在多尺度分子基准上考察有效性、FCD 与质量-效率权衡，还演示了基于 latent 空间分类器的性质引导与有效性感知生成。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 的关联仅是「在 latent 空间生成并延迟解码」这一形式线索；论文属分子图生成、不涉及视觉或多模态推理，是否对 VLM 推理状态生成与 latent 使用有借鉴意义尚不确定。
